messages:
Marta: Quick morning async — what I did / blockers / today
Marta: Did final pass on the v2 routing PR and merged after tests passed. small follow-up doc update pending.
Evan: Nice, saw the merge. thanks!
Marta: Blocker: infra needs to toggle the dedicated-cache kv prewarm flag in staging before we can run canary traffic.
Ops-bot: deploy job #4523 queued for staging — ETA ~5m. https://ci.redwood.example/4523
Jin: I can follow up with infra, @marta — pinging them now.
Kira: UX note: if we change cache TTL we should show a transient banner in Console. I have a tiny patch ready to preview.
Evan: Today I'll finish canary config and open the CR. need a quick review from @jin on the scale policy.
Jin: I'll do the CR after standup. also noticed a flaky assertion in the long-tail latency test, investigating root cause.
Marta: Prioritization question: include model-variant fallback in the initial canary or defer to next week?
Evan: Recommend include fallback for safety — small cost bump but reduces risk of user-facing regressions.
Marta: ok adding fallback to canary scope. @kira can you sign off on the fallback UX by EOD?
Kira: Yes, I'll post updated spec in #product-docs with screenshots and a short flowchart.
Ops-bot: staging deploy started — job #4523 running (logs: https://ci.redwood.example/4523/logs).
Marta: CR ping — @jin @evan please review #8745 when you have a minute.
Jin: on it, aim to review within ~2h.
Evan: FYI I updated the config snippet in the PR:
```
autoscale:
  min: 2
  max: 8
  bump_on_canary: true
```
Marta: thanks. if infra finishes prewarm and deploy is green I'll hand off canary monitoring to @evan for the first 2 hours.
Evan: Got it — will watch latency and error-rate panels. will post quick roll-forward plan in thread if anything spikes.
Marta: Anything else? If not, I'm unblocking docs updates and will merge the small spec follow-ups later today. :thumbsup:
